name: Getting started checklist
description: A short, ordered checklist that walks a new account to its first real result, in the plain framework-notification style.

origin.note: Design homage to Laravel's default markdown mail (MIT). Markup, tokens and copy are this package's own; the proportions, the centred blue button and the raw-URL fallback are deliberately familiar.

subject: Three steps to your first {{ product.name }} result
preheader: Each one takes a couple of minutes, and you can stop after the first if you like.

user.first_name.description: Recipient's first name. Used in the greeting line.

intro.description: Opening paragraph. Say what the checklist is worth, not that it exists.
intro.default: You're set up. These three steps take about five minutes between them, and at the end you'll have sent something real.

completed_count.description: How many steps are already done. Shown as progress so the email is honest about where they actually are.

total_count.description: How many steps there are in total.

steps_heading.description: Label introducing the list, so the steps arrive with a name rather than appearing out of nowhere.

steps.description: Ordered steps, each with a `text` label and an optional `detail` line.

example.detail: So messages come from you, not from us

action_url.description: Where the primary button goes — straight into the next step, not a generic dashboard.

help_text.description: Offer of help, placed after the action where someone stuck would look for it.
help_text.default: Stuck on any of them? Reply to this email and a person will read it.

docs_url.description: Optional link to written instructions, for people who would rather not reply.

signoff.description: Sign-off line above the sender name.

fallback_note.description: The trouble-clicking line that precedes the raw URL. Familiar to the point of invisibility, and genuinely useful when a button is stripped.
fallback_note.default: If you're having trouble with the button above, copy and paste the URL below into your web browser:
